purpose: cfm_todo.json::blockers[BLK-C-OBJ].required_before_any_design[0] -- measure the precious-metal geometry axes before tuning any objective against them.

protocol.embedder: RDKit ETKDG, useRandomCoords=True, maxAttempts=1, randomSeed=0xF00D, with Chem.AddHs
protocol.planarity_criterion: s3/s2 of donor positions about their centroid; <= cut => square_planar at CN=4
protocol.cohort_population_note: REAL_DFT is drawn from the 6,872 six-train-metal molecules that have coordinates in tmQM_X1.xyz.gz, which is a SUBSET of the 108,541 rows in tmqm_parsed.csv (34,970 frames total). The population is intersected BEFORE the cap is applied.

GENERATED.label: GENERATED (our bond head, free ODE generation)

REAL_ETKDG.label: REAL_ETKDG (real tmQM SMILES, same embedder as GENERATED)

coordination_number_mean.verdict: generator gap EXCEEDS the embedder floor

cn4_planarity_ratio.verdict: generator gap is WITHIN the embedder floor -- not a finding

metal_bond_length_A.verdict: generator gap EXCEEDS the embedder floor

interpretation_rules: GENERATED is read against REAL_ETKDG. REAL_DFT is the ground truth but the GENERATED cohort cannot be DFT, so a GENERATED-vs-REAL_DFT difference is partly the embedder's.
If |GENERATED - REAL_ETKDG| is not larger than |REAL_DFT - REAL_ETKDG|, the honest reading is that the generator is within the resolution of this instrument, not that it matches reality.
geometry_unmeasured counts molecules that failed to embed. They are never scored as zero.
geometry_implausible_rejected counts geometries ETKDG returned SUCCESSFULLY for that contain a sub-1.5 A metal-ligand contact. The filter is applied identically to all three cohorts.
GENERATED n=66. Any difference smaller than the within-cohort spread is reported as not-a-finding.
CN=6 is reported as octahedral_like (trans-pair test), never as octahedral: the planarity ratio gives 1.0 for BOTH an ideal octahedron and an ideal trigonal prism and cannot separate them.

corrections_2026_10_12.raised_by: adversarial review of the coord-geometry stream + this synthesis pass
what_was_wrong: PROTOCOL DRIFT. REAL_DFT is drawn from the six train metals THAT HAVE COORDINATES; REAL_ETKDG is drawn from the six train metals in the csv. At --real-limit 3000 the two draws share MEASURED 329 molecules, i.e. 2,671 of 3,000 (89%) of the DFT cohort is absent from the cohort labelled 'the same real molecules'. The embedder_fidelity_control therefore compares two populations and cannot separate the embedder effect from a population difference. FIXED AND RE-MEASURED: see metrics/by_metric/cfm_metal_geometry_pairing_control.json.

REFERENCE BAND. REAL_DFT coordination number is a 2.6 A donor window over the xyz frame; REAL_ETKDG and GENERATED coordination number is RDKit graph degree. MEASURED on identical molecules the two definitions agree on only 78.33% (n=600). A coordination-number gap quoted across the cohorts contains that definition gap.

SCOPE. Both the docstring and this file's cohort_population_note say the six-metal-with-coordinates population is 6,872. MEASURED: 6,872 counts rows regardless of SMILES; with the SMILES filter the code actually applies it is 5,754 (Re 807, Ru 1451, Os 243, Ir 1007, Rh 745, Pt 1501). 20% overstated in the emitted provenance note.

FACTUAL ERROR in a pinned test docstring (molmetal/tests/test_wf_blk_c_obj_metal_geometry.py): 'Pt is the single most common metal in real tmQM (8,275 of 33,429 six-metal rows)'. MEASURED within those same 33,429 rows: Ru 9,800 > Pt 8,275 > Ir 5,232 > Rh 4,640 > Re 4,172 > Os 1,310. Pt is not the most common.

surviving_findings.embedder_erases_the_square_planar_pharma: HOLDS, and is the one central claim that survives. PAIRED, molecule for molecule (MEASURED, n=600 with 99 paired CN=4 scores, cfm_metal_geometry_pairing_control.json): 91 of the 99 molecules whose DFT geometry is square-planar become TETRAHEDRAL under ETKDG. Table: dft=square_planar|etkdg=tetrahedral 91, dft=tetrahedral|etkdg=tetrahedral 6, dft=square_planar|etkdg=unmeasured 2. Any square-planar number derived from generated SMILES is a statement about ETKDG, not about the generator.
surviving_findings.cn4_planarity_ratio: NOT A FINDING. Generator gap 0.0227 against a paired embedder floor of 0.7642. The shipped file's own verdict field already says 'WITHIN the embedder floor -- not a finding'; the CN-mean and bond-length rows survive the paired control (gap 1.1312 vs floor 0.2267; gap 0.1344 vs floor 0.0563).
surviving_findings.zero_platinum: MEASURED instrument-blocking fact. GENERATED contains 0 Pt across all 66 molecules while REAL_DFT contains 3,571 Pt metal-ligand bonds. The cisplatin square-planar pharmacophore cannot be assessed on our output at all. This is below the GENERATED n=66 resolution floor and is reported as what can be measured, not as a generator finding.

corrections_2026_10_12.status: findings above are re-measured in cfm_metal_geometry_pairing_control.json; the population note and the pairing must be corrected before this file is cited for a CN gap.

corrections_2026_10_12.what_is_new: The zero-Pt finding has a PATCH on disk. molmetal/data/tmqm_clouds.py::load_tmqm_clouds(..., min_per_metal: int = 0) was added 2026-10-12; when min_per_metal>=1 the loader back-fills reservoir slots so every requested metal is represented. The 'GENERATED contains 0 Pt' finding in this file's earlier correction block is therefore NOT a permanent property of the model -- it is a property of the seed=0 val window at n_clouds=192. The patch is verified: min_per_metal=1, n=192 -> Pt 53/192 = 27.6% (vs 25.2% real); min_per_metal=20, n=960 -> Pt 230/960 = 23.96%.
corrections_2026_10_12.what_this_does_NOT_change: Nothing in this file's GENERATED block. The numbers above (4.8788 mean CN, 0 Pt bonds, 0.8738 mean cn4 planarity) remain the description of the n=66 seed=0 val-window cohort that was generated against the old (Pt=0) template window. Re-running the seed=0 panel with min_per_metal=20 and n_clouds=960 will produce a different cohort and different numbers; this file will need a new entry in this same corrections array when that happens.
what_becomes_invalid_for_precious_metal_: Any generalisation of the GENERATED bond-length / CN / donor preferences to the precious-metal-anticancer axis. These numbers describe a cohort with no Pt.

Any read of `embedder_fidelity_control.coordination_number_mean.generated_minus_real_etkdg = -1.0795` as a finding about Pt(II) complexes. The two cohorts in that comparison both lack the precious-metal sub-population that the user's directive asks about.
what_survives: The cn4 planarity finding (n=5, 0.8738 mean) -- not Pt-specific, not invalidated.
The non-metal-specific findings: 64% of donors are C, 19% N, 9% P; the chiral-centre penalty share of the SA gap (69.3%).
